sql.if: WHERE TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR WRITER LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

mapper.select: SELECT B.BOARD_ID, B.TITLE, B.WRITER, B.VIEW_CNT, B.REG_DT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_FILE F WHERE F.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID) AS FILE_CNT FROM (SELECT * FROM BOARD ) B ORDER BY B.BOARD_ID DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT BOARD_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, VIEW_CNT, REG_DT FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (BOARD_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{writer})
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, WRITER = #{writer} WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
UPDATE BOARD SET VIEW_CNT = VIEW_CNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_ID, BOARD_ID, ORIG_NAME, STORED_NAME, FILE_SIZE, CONTENT_TYPE FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} ORDER BY FILE_ID
SELECT FILE_ID, BOARD_ID, ORIG_NAME, STORED_NAME, FILE_SIZE, CONTENT_TYPE FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_FILE (FILE_ID, BOARD_ID, ORIG_NAME, STORED_NAME, FILE_SIZE, CONTENT_TYPE) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{boardId}, #{origName}, #{storedName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType})
